newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-BORDER LOSE TOSS, BAT FIRST AGAINST W.P.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BORDER LOSE TOSS, BAT FIRST AGAINST W.P.

text.p: Western Province captain Eric Simons won the toss and asked Border to bat on the opening day of the Supersport Series four-day match at Newlands on Friday.
Western Province - Sven Koenig, Desmond Haynes, Jacques Kallis, H.D. Ackerman, Eric Simons (captain), Faeik Davids, Paul Kirsten, Alan Dawson, Craig Matthews, Meyrick Pringle, Brett Schultz.
Border - Piet Botha, Brad White, Steven Pope, Peter Kirsten, Pieter Strydom, Frans Cronje, Mark Boucher, Vasbert Drakes, Brenden Fourie, Peter Emslie, Mkhaya Ntinie.
